text:
laura: Quick sync — we're lining up a joint go-to-market with SentinelHSM (hardware), NorthStar SI, and CloudMarket for a combined SSO/SCIM + KMS/HSM integration next sprint. Need a compact checklist and owners so we can hit the marketplace onboarding and the press blurb. Targeting a soft launch window Tue 2024-11-12. Who can own which items?

mike: I can own the SI end-to-end with NorthStar. Will get their integration runbook and test plan.

anita: Security here — I need: HSM attestation report, KMS key policy sample, threat model sign-off, and a pen-test window. Also we should require HSM firmware version >= 2.4.1.

peter: Marketplace/partner listing: I'll draft the listing copy and request logos. Need SSO metadata (SAML descriptor) and a short 2-line product blurb. ETA for assets?

laura: Great. Propose owners: Mike=SI integrations/tests, Peter=marketplace assets + launch copy, Anita=security + compliance checks, Elena/legal for contracts. I'll own coordination and the rollout policy.

elena: Legal here — will need a partner addendum (data processing + liability carveouts for HSM usage). Can turn around NDA/PO terms by Fri EOD if we get the partner contact and expected data flows. Tagging in the partner legal lead request.

mike: NorthStar asked about SCIM mapping for groups and role entitlements. Sending sample mapping to embed in docs.

laura: Please paste the SCIM mapping snippet here — we'll include in the integration guide.

mike: Sure — sample mapping:```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "user.email",
  "name": {"givenName":"user.givenName","familyName":"user.familyName"},
  "groups": "urn:custom:groups"
}
```

anita: For KMS/HSM ops, we need a minimal verification command for customers to run after provisioning. Suggest adding this to the onboarding docs:
```bash
# verify KMS key policy attached to Redwood service principal
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <KEY_ID> --policy-name default | jq .
# HSM attestation (partner-specific)
hsmctl attest --device /dev/hsm0 --output json
```

peter: For SAML, partner wants our metadata endpoint and a cert thumbprint. We'll provide an endpoint: https://api.redwood.com/saml/metadata and a temporary cert for testing.

laura: Ops notes: we should plan a canary route in Redwood Dedicated to route 5% to the HSM-backed KMS variant and fallback to software KMS on failure. Also enable verbose logging for first 48h.

deploy-bot: deployment-schedule: Canary route config created in staging (canary=5%); scheduled dry-run for 2024-11-08 03:00 UTC.

anita: Also logging: redact token and key ids in logs; only show key alias. Confirmed with SRE.

mike: NorthStar will provide a test instance and sample data by Wed. I'll sync test matrix (SAML login, SCIM provisioning, sign/unwrap via HSM).

elena: Legal: also need to confirm data residency constraints if keys or signing operations are routed through partner infrastructure. Please flag in doc.

laura: Action items (short):
- Mike: SI test plan + SCIM mapping (due Wed)
- Peter: marketplace copy + logos + SAML metadata stub (due Thu)
- Anita: security checklist + attestation requirements + logging redaction (due Thu)
- Elena: partner addendum draft + residency check (due Fri)
- Laura: rollout policy + canary config + press sync (due Mon)

laura: I'll assemble a single playbook doc and share a staging runbook link. If anyone needs to reassign, say now. Otherwise I'll ping the partner contact and start the legal loop.

peter: ack from me, will ask marketing for a short quote and logo files.

anita: ack — will post the security checklist into the playbook when ready.

mike: ack, will post SI runbook and test vectors here.

elena: ack, looping legal.

laura: Thanks all — I'll update thread with the playbook URL once created. :white_check_mark:
